name: Subhadra Yojana
description: Transformational women empowerment initiative by Government of Odisha providing substantial annual financial vouchers to over 1 crore women.
descriptionHindi: ओडिशा सरकार द्वारा 1 करोड़ से अधिक महिलाओं को आर्थिक रूप से सशक्त बनाने हेतु ₹10,000 वार्षिक सहायता योजना।
ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Odisha
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹10,000 per year paid in two installments of ₹5,000 each (on Rakhi Purnima and International Women's Day) for 5 years (total ₹50,000).
eligibilityText: Women residents of Odisha aged between 21 and 60 years covered under NFSA/SFSS or from economically disadvantaged families.
eligibilityTextHindi: ओडिशा की 21 से 60 वर्ष की महिलाएं जिनका परिवार राशन कार्ड धारक हो तथा जो आयकरदाता न हों।
